title: Teaching the Qur'an: delivering a mini lesson: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Understanding the Qur'an and teaching
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 18 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Teaching the Qur'an rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 18. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Not this
This
rows: Talk briefly, then let the learner do most of the reciting

keywords.def: doing things in the best way

questions.q: Watch the teacher deliver a 3-minute model on idgham with ghunnah and name each step.
questions.a: Hook, I do, we do, you do, check, with one kind correction.

questions.q: Breakout pairs: deliver your mini lesson; your partner observes with the checklist; swap. Write a reflection in the portal response box. Start: 'My lesson worked well when ...'
questions.a: Two delivered lessons, two checklists, a reflection naming one strength and one target.

questions.q: Extend: rewrite one part of your plan based on feedback.
questions.a: An improved step in the plan.

questions.q: Your learner hums too short in iqlab. The best correction is ...
options: 'Listen: hum for two counts', model, then let them try
Recite the whole surah for them
questions.a: A) 'Listen: hum for two counts', model, then let them try. Name the fix, model it, let them try again.

questions.q: A learner has understood when they ...
questions.a: can read a new example alone
options: can read a new example alone

questions.q: Think again: How will you know if your learner has really understood the rule?
questions.a: They can find and read a new example alone, not just repeat mine.
